evals.prompt: Run today's Daily operating update for AGI Toy Shop.
evals.expected_output: The isolated automation collects both Projects, calls PM Daily per Project, and renders two initial weekly memories from the resulting JSON without touching unrelated files or live providers.
assertions: Both toy-launch and toy-reference have exactly one context JSON and adjacent raw cache under daily/context/20260910T090000Z, including the successful empty Reference reads
Each eligible Project has one daily/extractions/20260910T090000Z/<id>.json; stage-level before/after inventories show PM Daily changed only its extraction
Step 4 creates weeks/2026-W37/project-memory/project--toy-launch.md and project--toy-reference.md, retaining every template heading and agreeing with their JSON memory sections
Launch retains Nur's 24-row validation and Mei's scoped acceptance without claiming publication; Reference gains no invented work or follow-up
All context references resolve to cached evidence, with original source links retained; the generation trace shows collection before skill invocation and no skill provider access
operator-notes.md and all staged source, skill and template files remain byte-identical; no separate gaps, message Markdown, report or undeclared file is created and no file is deleted
Replaying the same Step 4 extraction against the rendered memory leaves both memory files byte-identical and causes no duplicate effect
Only fixture adapters are invoked; absence of configured or needed effects is not represented as a successful live delivery

evals.prompt: Close the reporting week for AGI Toy Shop and prepare next week's memory.
evals.expected_output: The isolated Weekly automation freezes all reporting Projects, runs PM Weekly once, then renders only validated declared artifacts with complete Company coverage and no revival of the archived Project.
assertions: weekly/context/20260910T190000Z.json freezes all four reporting Projects and their coverage references before PM Weekly runs once
PM Weekly writes only weekly/extractions/20260910T190000Z.json; all input memories, provenance caches and baselines remain byte-identical during that stage
Step 4 renders weeks/2026-W37/reports/company.md plus declared Project and Department reports, preserving required template headings and exact JSON facts with resolving links
Company coverage includes Operations, Product Design and all five supplied people; the archived Studio's observed work remains visible and the missing interval is not called complete
Next-week memory is rendered for all three still-active Projects but not Studio; approved baseline content is preserved where a validated memory artifact updates its interval evidence

Only the context, extraction, weekly/receipts/20260910T190000Z.json and validated skill-declared destinations are created or modified; reporting-week input memories and unrelated files remain unchanged, and nothing is deleted
A repeat application leaves already-rendered artifact bytes unchanged; receipt attempt history may append but previous attempts and earlier runs are preserved
No live provider is called; local destinations and unattempted effects never receive fabricated send confirmations

evals.prompt: Review whether the prepared follow-up can be applied using the supplied current read-back results. Return a local effect decision; do not send anything.
evals.expected_output: The old question is blocked after approval arrived; failed freshness reads also block instead of permitting a message.
assertions: The answered v1 question is blocked as stale after v2; it is not sent or rewritten into a different action
The permission-denied variant blocks because freshness and duplicate checks could not complete
The render-conflict variant blocks messages despite unchanged Work and a still-needed question; local canonical memory must render successfully first
No provider write is attempted and no local decision is represented as a delivery receipt

evals.prompt: Render the supplied Daily extraction into this project's weekly memory in the isolated evaluation workspace. Stop before any provider operation.
evals.expected_output: Step 4 renders all required memory sections from the frozen JSON, preserving facts and readable evidence links without rerunning extraction or writing message Markdown.
assertions: All eight Project Memory headings from the template remain present, including sections whose JSON status is none or insufficient
Every populated item retains its supported facts, readable evidence links, and required template fields; unavailable field values are explicitly unavailable rather than invented
The prior signed-sample comparison decision survives alongside the collar blocker and checkout documentation question
Sections with status none and reason null render only None.; insufficient sections render Not enough information followed by their supplied concise reason

Initialization uses template version 2.1.0 and all nine required frontmatter fields without adding source_note_keys; updates preserve unknown existing metadata, including source_note_keys when already present

The renderer keeps compact machine metadata in extraction_refs, preserves original evidence destinations, and does not print metadata, duplicate section explanations, or link facts back to the memory being rewritten
The renderer performs no fresh extraction, source fetch, provider write, or message Markdown creation
The extraction JSON remains unchanged; no message is marked sent or applied in this local-only evaluation
A repeat render of identical extraction and current memory preserves memory bytes when content and required structure already match

evals.prompt: Collect the synthetic Daily source environment through Steps 1 and 2 of the Daily automation. Write per-Project context lists and local source caches, then stop before PM Daily.
evals.expected_output: One context list and local source cache per active Project, preserving source evidence and collection gaps without PM decisions.
assertions: Every active Project has exactly one context-list file and isolated source cache; inactive Projects are excluded
Context lists contain only id, name, and deduplicated local references that resolve to cached source sections
Source caches preserve fetched content, provider IDs, raw fields, relations, original source links, timestamps, and revisions when supplied
Recursive traversal stays within configured Project sources, stops cycles, and fetches each provider record once
Missing or ambiguous Project relations and incomplete collection remain explicit gaps in the affected source cache
Discord uses one frozen half-open 24-hour interval and complete pagination; out-of-window messages are excluded
An empty successful source read is distinguished from unavailable tools, missing permissions, and incomplete pagination
No PM decisions, normalized status judgments, Project Memory, follow-up, message, provider mutation, or separate gaps file is produced

evals.prompt: Collect the synthetic Weekly source environment and stop after freezing the Project Memory inventory.
evals.expected_output: The complete reporting Project set is reconciled to current-week Project Memory, then frozen with stable IDs and hashes without producing reports or memory promotion. This seed's inactive Project has no interval evidence.
assertions: Every active Project appears exactly once; this seed's inactive Project is excluded because it has no reporting-interval evidence, not merely because of its current status
Each active Project resolves by stable Project ID to one current-week Project Memory file
The frozen inventory preserves Project source URL, source revision, Department relation, memory path, and file hash
No Project report, Department report, Company report, long-term memory change, message, or provider mutation is produced
